You are evaluating a software engineering task for repository psf/black.

Problem Statement:
Fix GitHub Action crash on dependency-group includes

### Description

With `use_pyproject: true`, the GitHub Action crashes before installing Black when any
`[dependency-groups]` array contains an `{include-group = "..."}` table, which the
[dependency-groups specification](https://packaging.python.org/en/latest/specifications/dependency-groups/)
allows (Black's own `pyproject.toml` uses them):

```toml
[dependency-groups]
dev = [{include-group = "lint"}]
lint = ["black==26.5.1"]
```

```
AttributeError: 'dict' object has no attribute 'split'
```

`find_black_version_in_array()` calls `.split(";")` on every entry. Because
`read_version_specifier_from_pyproject()` already scans every dependency group (and then
`project.dependencies` / optional dependencies), an included group is checked on its own,
so the fix only needs to skip non-string entries. Lookup order and version handling are
unchanged; this does not add include resolution or combine specifiers across groups
(deliberately deferred in #4606).

The crash also happens when an unrelated earlier group contains an include and the Black
pin lives in a later group or in `project.dependencies`.

Tests: `tests/test_github_action.py` runs the whole `action/main.py` entrypoint via
`runpy` with `subprocess.run` mocked, and checks the requirement passed to `pip install`
and the formatter invocation. Cases cover includes before/after a pin, a pin inside the
included group, an unrelated include before a `project.dependencies` pin, plain project
pins, extras + markers, and the existing "unpinned" / "missing" error paths. Four of the
eight cases fail with the `AttributeError` above without the fix.

AI assistance (OpenAI Codex / Claude) was used to investigate and prepare this change; the
diff was reviewed before submission.
